newsitem.title: USA: Furniture Brands shareholder sells shares.
newsitem.headline: Furniture Brands shareholder sells shares.

text.p: Furniture Brands International Inc said Friday its largest shareholder sold its holdings and its representatives have resigned from the company's board.

Furniture Brands said a previously announced secondary offering of 11 million shares of its common stock owned by Apollo Investment Fund L.P. and Lion Advisors L.P. has been completed. The shares were offered at $17 each. All proceeds from the offering were retained by the selling stockholders.

At the same time, Furniture Brands completed a previously announced agreement with Apollo and Lion to buy 10,842,299 shares of its common stock at $15.50 a share. The company also repurchased from Apollo its 290,821 series 1 warrants for $8.37 each, representing $15.50 minus the $7.13 per warrant exercise price.
To finance the share and warrant repurchase, which totaled $170 million, Furniture Brands said it arranged a non-amortizing ten-year senior bank pact.
Following these transactions, Apollo and Lion will no longer own any shares of the company's stock and all eight Apollo representatives have resigned from the company's board.

"Apollo has been a very supportive stockholder since its investment in 1991, and we are pleased to see its investment being brought to a successful conclusion," said Mickey Holliman, president and chief executive officer, in a news release.
Furniture Brands companies include Broyhill, Lane and Thomasville.
